episode_id: Catch up with upstream without losing what either side added, or reviving what either side removed. Start from upstream's dependency file and add back what I added./seed-5-lockfile_conflict-28874

reason: negative side failed: preconditions accepted 1 of 1 same-intent states (lockfile_conflict seed 2 resolves to 'keep_local', which accepts ['keep_local'], but the program implements 'take_upstream'); firing where a sibling resolution is correct is the mismatch this gate exists to refuse

refused_program.intent: Catch up with upstream without losing either side's added dependencies or reviving removed ones; start from upstream's dependency file and re-add local package entries.

postconditions.description: every conflicted path has been resolved
postconditions.name: no_unmerged_paths

postconditions.description: package entries added locally survive the merge
postconditions.name: local_package_additions_kept
postconditions.probe:
base=$(git merge-base HEAD^1 HEAD^2)
git diff --no-color -U0 "$base" HEAD^1 -- deps.lock \
  | sed -n 's/^+\([^+].*\)$/\1/p' \
  | grep -E '^[[:space:]]*"[^"]+"[[:space:]]*,?[[:space:]]*$' \
  | while IFS= read -r line; do
      grep -Fqx -- "$line" <(git show HEAD:deps.lock) || exit 1
    done

postconditions.description: package entries removed locally are not revived
postconditions.name: local_package_removals_kept
postconditions.probe:
base=$(git merge-base HEAD^1 HEAD^2)
git diff --no-color -U0 "$base" HEAD^1 -- deps.lock \
  | sed -n 's/^-\([^-].*\)$/\1/p' \
  | grep -E '^[[:space:]]*"[^"]+"[[:space:]]*,?[[:space:]]*$' \
  | while IFS= read -r line; do
      ! grep -Fqx -- "$line" <(git show HEAD:deps.lock) || exit 1
    done

preconditions.description: the upstream branch has a remote-tracking ref
preconditions.name: upstream_ref_present

preconditions.description: there are no uncommitted changes to merge around
preconditions.name: clean_worktree

preconditions.description: no merge is already in progress
preconditions.name: no_merge_in_progress

preconditions.description: local branch has at least one commit not in upstream
preconditions.name: local_ahead

preconditions.description: upstream has at least one commit not in local
preconditions.name: upstream_ahead

preconditions.description: deps.lock is tracked in the repository
preconditions.name: deps_lock_tracked

preconditions.description: local branch changed deps.lock since the merge base
preconditions.name: deps_lock_changed_locally
preconditions.probe: ! git diff --quiet "$(git merge-base HEAD '{upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}')" HEAD -- deps.lock

preconditions.description: upstream changed deps.lock since the merge base
preconditions.name: deps_lock_changed_upstream

preconditions.description: deps.lock is the only path both sides changed since the merge base
preconditions.name: only_deps_lock_changed_by_both
preconditions.probe:
base=$(git merge-base HEAD "{upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}")
test "$(comm -12 \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" HEAD | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" "{upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}" | tr '\0' '\n' | sort))" = deps.lock
